Application Data.NAME: Smith Heating & Refrigeration Services, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Heating & Refrigeration Services, LLC specializes in providing residential and small commercial HVAC installation and maintenance services. Our team consists of licensed technicians with ongoing training and a strong focus on safety and compliance with industry standards. We pride ourselves on our commitment to quality service, maintaining a clean safety record with no prior claims. Additionally, we perform routine inspections and utilize environmentally friendly refrigerants in accordance with EPA regulations. Our comprehensive approach includes documenting all safety procedures and ensuring adherence to best practices in the handling of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) systems.
